title: SAR-Flood-Surrogate: code for SAR-constrained flood inundation surrogate modelling
description: Deep learning code for rapid flood extent mapping using SAR observations and physical predictors. Includes Vanilla U-Net and ResNet34 U-Net implementations, training scripts with spatial split support, evaluation tools, and utilities for the July 2023 Daqinghe River flood study. Model weights available separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23465452
